**BLUF**  
Russian forces conducted a large-scale overnight missile and drone attack on Ukraine (11–12 Sep), killing at least 11 civilians and injuring dozens while targeting industrial, logistics, and port facilities; Ukrainian air defenses intercepted most but not all targets. Houthi forces completed seizure of Perim (Mayyun) Island in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, tightening control over a key chokepoint. Belarus President Lukashenko ordered a full army inspection down to mobilization readiness. Activity in other theatres remained at baseline or routine levels with no verified consequential shifts in the window.

## 1. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Al Jazeera, RFE/RL, RBC-Ukraine, Kyiv Independent and Euronews (12 Sep, morning UTC) reported Russian forces launched ~129 drones (including jet-powered Shahed-type), Iskander ballistic missiles, Kalibr cruise missiles and Kh-59/69 missiles overnight, striking Zaporizhstal steel plant in Zaporizhzhia, Interpipe in Dnipro, facilities in Kryvyi Rih, cargo vessels in Chornomorsk port and residential areas in Odesa; at least 11 killed and 96 injured across regions including Odesa, Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk.[[1]](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/12/russia-strikes-cargo-vessels-steel-plants-across-ukraine)[[2]](https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-russia-strikes-odesa-zapporizhzhia-missile-shahed-drones/33852877.html)[[3]](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attacks-kill-11-injure-96-across-ukraine-as-odesa-comes-under-mass-overnight-strike/)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Ukrainian Air Force (12 Sep, ~08:30 local) stated 110 of the targets were destroyed or suppressed, with hits recorded at 20 locations.[[4]](https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/overnight-russian-attack-on-ukraine-air-defense-1789194091.html)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Russian Defence Ministry claimed strikes on Ukrainian military supply hubs, ports and industrial sites used for drone production.[[5]](https://www.news18.com/world/russia-hammers-ukrainian-military-supply-hubs-ports-in-overnight-strikes-ws-l-10324819.html)

### MIDDLE EAST
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Reuters, CGTN, BBC and multiple Yemeni government sources (12 Sep, early UTC) confirmed Houthi forces seized Perim (Mayyun) Island in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait after government troops withdrew, following capture of Mocha and Dhubab; Houthis now claim full grip on the strait’s approaches.[[6]](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-09-12/Houthis-seize-Perim-Island-tightening-grip-on-Bab-al-Mandab-Strait-1Qn4p1IIpyw/p.html)[[7]](https://www.brecorder.com/news/40439116)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Saudi-backed Yemeni government sources reported the advance tightens Houthi control over the chokepoint, with statements that navigation remains safe except for Saudi vessels.[[8]](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c23x72yx2rvo)

### INDO-PACIFIC
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Taiwan News / MND (12 Sep, reporting period ending 06:00 local) tracked 7 Chinese military aircraft (5 crossing median line) and 8 naval/official vessels; Taiwan responded with aircraft, ships and missile deployments.[[9]](https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/news/6438650)

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### AFRICA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### AMERICAS
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential (oil price movements tied to prior Houthi actions already noted in previous brief).

## 2. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
- [SIGINT - VERIFIED] CISA (12 Sep) published updated joint guidance with FBI on Akira ransomware targeting small businesses and critical infrastructure.[[10]](https://insidecybersecurity.com/daily-news/cisa-fbi-update-guidance-ransomware-threat-impacting-small-businesses)
- [SIGINT - VERIFIED] CISA KEV catalog updates continued, with federal patch deadlines active (e.g., Cisco, Citrix, Fortinet flaws due 12 Sep).[[11]](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/cisa-flags-exploited-cisco-citrix.html)

## 3. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window. No incidents affecting civil aviation, rail, ports, power, water, or telecoms reported. No change to domestic critical infrastructure posture.

**Assessment (Europe/Russia-Ukraine):** The overnight strike marks continued Russian pressure on Ukrainian industrial and logistics capacity ahead of winter, with higher civilian casualties than recent days; Ukrainian intercepts remain effective but incomplete, sustaining attrition on both sides’ deep-strike and air-defence resources. Russia’s position improves marginally through demonstrated reach; Ukraine’s improves through ongoing retaliation claims on Russian territory. Watch for follow-on Ukrainian strikes on Russian refining or energy targets.

**Assessment (Middle East):** Houthi consolidation on Perim Island shifts the threat from harassment to potential territorial control of a critical strait, raising risks of mining, boarding or sustained interdiction; this strengthens Iran’s proxy leverage while pressuring Saudi Arabia and global shipping. Saudi position weakens; Houthi/Iran position strengthens. Watch for immediate shipping incidents or coalition responses.

**Assessment (remaining sections):** No material shifts detected.

**INDICATORS AND WARNINGS**  
- Expanded Houthi attacks or effective blockade on non-Saudi shipping through Bab el-Mandeb → further insurance spikes and Suez rerouting → first visible in Lloyd’s List or maritime tracking.  
- Belarus mobilization orders or large-scale exercises near Ukrainian border → heightened NATO air policing or intelligence alerts → first in Belarus state media or Ukrainian reporting.  
- Confirmed exploitation of new JFrog/ConnectWise or recent Cisco/Citrix KEVs in critical infrastructure → broader campaign targeting edge devices → CISA incident notification or sector alerts.  
- Surge in PLA aircraft/naval activity east of Taiwan beyond baseline → testing of blockade or gray-zone escalation → Taiwan MND daily reports.  
- Additional Ukrainian strikes on Russian refining/logistics → Russian retaliation on Ukrainian energy/urban targets → Ukrainian Air Force or regional governor statements.

**COLLECTION GAPS**  
- Independent confirmation of exact damage and casualties from Russian strikes on Ukrainian sites and any Ukrainian deep strikes in the window.  
- Full scope of Houthi control over Perim Island and any immediate shipping incidents or Saudi/coalition responses.  
- Details on any Belarus mobilization timeline or specific units affected.  
- Verification of any unreported strikes or incidents in quiet theatres (South/Central Asia, Africa, Americas).
